Terms of Service

Last updated: January 15, 2025

1. Service Description

Fetchlab is a professional API testing and management application for iOS. It provides tools for sending HTTP requests, organizing API collections, running pre/post scripts, and monitoring API performance.

2. Account Terms

You must provide a valid email address to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials. You must be at least 13 years of age to use this service.

3. Subscription & Billing

Fetchlab offers free and paid subscription plans. Paid subscriptions are billed through the Apple App Store. All prices are in USD and may vary by region.

  • Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
  • You can manage or cancel your subscription through your App Store settings.
  • Refunds are handled by Apple according to their App Store refund policies.
  • We reserve the right to change pricing with 30 days advance notice.

4. Acceptable Use

You agree not to use Fetchlab to:
